disorder-name.detail: Clinical autism spectrum disorder cohort; participants had an existing ASD diagnosis according to DSM-5/ICD-10 criteria.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Individuals with an existing ASD and/or mild ID diagnosis (according to DSM-5/ICD-10 criteria) were recruited"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Clinical cohort was drawn from the Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP), a multisite cohort spanning Cambridge, KCL, Mannheim, Nijmegen, Rome, and Utrecht.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "we included all participants from the Longitudinal European Autism Project (40) cohort"

age.detail: Overall ASD clinical cohort. Range was stated in the Participants section; mean and SD were reported in Table 1.
age.supporting_text: "We included 206 TD individuals 7 to 31 years of age (127 males) ... and 321 individuals 6 to 31 years of age with ASD (232 males)."; "Age, Years | 17.01 6 5.79"

sex.detail: Counts reported directly for the ASD cohort; percentages calculated from N=321. Table 1 reports the same cohort as n=321 (89 female).
sex.supporting_text: "321 individuals 6 to 31 years of age with ASD (232 males)."; "ASD Cohort, n = 321 (89 Female)"
